subject: general
question: Which neighbouring country did India accuse of supporting cross-border infiltration attempts in Jammu and Kashmir in early 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Pakistan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India** has often accused **Pakistan** of supporting cross-border infiltration attempts, particularly in the region of **Jammu and Kashmir**.
 
• This accusation is rooted in the longstanding conflict between the two nations regarding the **Kashmir issue**, which dates back to the **partition of British India in 1947**.
 
• Pakistan has been accused of providing support to **militant groups and separatists** operating in Jammu and Kashmir, which has led to tensions and border skirmishes.
 
• The infiltration often involves militants crossing the **Line of Control (LoC)**, a de facto border between Indian-administered and Pakistan-administered Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• India has taken measures to counter cross-border infiltration, such as implementing advanced surveillance technologies, constructing border fencing, and deploying additional troops along the LoC.
 
• International organizations and countries often urge both nations to resolve their differences through **diplomatic channels** and peaceful negotiations.
 
• The issue of cross-border infiltration is a significant aspect of the larger **India-Pakistan bilateral relations**, which are marked by periodic escalations and efforts for peace.
 
• The involvement of Pakistan in such activities is often condemned by India during international forums, aiming to garner support against terrorism and cross-border militancy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bangladesh**__

 __
 
• **Bangladesh** shares a long border with India but is not known for cross-border infiltration attempts in Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• India and Bangladesh have generally maintained a cooperative relationship, especially in resolving border disputes and addressing issues like illegal immigration.
 
• The **Ganga water-sharing treaty** and joint efforts to curb terrorism reflect their collaborative approach.
 
 
 
• **Sri Lanka**__
 __
 
• **Sri Lanka** is an island nation located to the south of India and does not share a land border with India.
 
• Its geographical position makes it irrelevant to cross-border infiltration issues in Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• India and Sri Lanka collaborate on maritime security and other regional concerns in the **Indian Ocean**.
 
 
 
• **Nepal**__
 
 
• **Nepal** shares a porous border with India but is not directly involved in infiltration attempts in Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• India and Nepal have a unique relationship based on **historical, cultural, and geographical ties**.
 
• There have been concerns about smuggling and illegal activities along the border, but these are unrelated to the Kashmir issue.
